description: What the remote app may ask of the shell. The app is the deployed origin, not bundled code, so it is granted exactly what a browser tab could not do for itself and nothing a tab already can. The updater, the process plugin and the shell's opener are deliberately absent: the shell updates itself from Rust and exposes one narrow `open_external` command, so a page that runs somebody else's script cannot make this process install software, restart itself, or hand a URL of any scheme to the operating system.
